target.title: Allow alternate Zalo Bot API roots
target.body:
## Summary

- allow the Zalo Bot API client to use a primitive alternate API root through `ZALO_API_URL`
- preserve explicit `apiUrl` option precedence and the existing production endpoint by default
- reject blank, malformed, non-HTTP(S), query-bearing, and fragment-bearing roots
- block the exact `ZALO_API_URL` key from untrusted workspace dotenv files while allowing trusted process/global dotenv input

This is a general provider endpoint seam. It adds no QA-specific code, no Crabline imports or naming, and no channel config schema.

## Tests

- `pnpm exec vitest run extensions/zalo/src/api.test.ts src/infra/dotenv.test.ts` (49 tests)
- `pnpm tsgo:test:extensions`
- `pnpm exec oxlint --deny-warnings --type-aware --tsconfig tsconfig.json extensions/zalo/src/api.ts extensions/zalo/src/api.test.ts src/infra/dotenv.ts src/infra/dotenv.test.ts`
- local HTTP roundtrip through the real Zalo `getMe` client path
- autoreview clean after addressing explicit blank-option precedence and URL suffix validation findings

`pnpm check:changed` passed its conflict, attribution, export, duplication, dependency, and core production typecheck gates, but the delegated test run currently fails on two unrelated `src/commands/daemon-install-helpers.test.ts` fixture type errors also present on current `main` (lines 487 and 1281). Run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28548582454
